title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession
description: Resting-state EEG recorded from patients with Parkinson's disease enrolled in a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of Neuroepo, an erythropoietin formulation with low sialic acid content. Recordings were acquired before and six months after drug administration in Neuroepo (n=15) and placebo (n=10) groups. The dataset supports qualitative EEG abnormality ratings and quantitative source-level EEG analysis, and is shared as raw EEG in BIDS format.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded at baseline and six months after administration of Neuroepo or placebo. Qualitative EEG abnormalities were rated by two experts on a Likert-type scale and analyzed with a multivariate item response theory approach. Quantitative EEG source analysis used VARETA with MNI atlas co-registration, followed by permutation tests and surfstat contrasts with Bonferroni correction.
